name: jwt-lens
description: A DevTools panel that reads the JWTs your app is actually sending — claims, live expiry, and rotation history — plus a web page for pasting one in.

scripts.package: npm run build && rm -f jwt-lens.zip && (cd dist && zip -qr ../jwt-lens.zip . -x '.*' -x '__MACOSX/*') && echo 'jwt-lens.zip ready — this is the file the Chrome Web Store wants'
